# Kalimat Plus

> Kalimat Plus (كلمات, "words") is a free, browser-based Fusha (Modern Standard Arabic) vocabulary trainer for learners moving beyond the basics, made by Ummah Apps. It follows on from Kalimat, the beginner trainer. URL: https://kalimat-plus.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- 302 Fusha words and phrases in five topics:
  - Discussion language (60): giving opinions (في رأيي، أعتقد أن، من وجهة نظري), agreeing and disagreeing, contrasting (لكنّ، بينما، في المقابل، على الرغم من), cause and effect (لأنّ، بسبب، لذلك، نتيجةً لذلك), examples, adding points and concluding. Formal linking words are labelled.
  - Religion and worship (51): prayer, wudu, fasting, zakat, sadaqah, Hajj, Umrah, Quran, dua, dhikr, iman, taqwa, tawbah and related verbs.
  - Tarbiyyah and upbringing (60): Islamic upbringing and parenting, adab, role models (qudwah), fitrah, values, habits, encouragement and reward, discipline, rights and duties, being dutiful to parents (birr al-walidayn), and verbs such as to raise (rabba), to discipline (addaba), to advise, to encourage and to obey.
  - Relationships and character (74): friendship, trust, respect, honesty, emotions, personality traits and related verbs.
  - Environment (57): climate, global warming, pollution, recycling, energy, natural disasters, sustainability and related verbs.
- Every entry has full harakat (vowel marks), an English meaning, and an example sentence in Arabic with an English translation.
- Verbs show the past tense, present tense and verbal noun (masdar). Nouns show their plural, labelled as a sound or broken plural.
- Words and sentences are spoken aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice at slow, normal or natural speed.
- Games: a multiple-choice reading quiz, "say it from memory", "say the verb forms" and "say the plural".
- Progress tracking: mark words as learned, then as known well. The game uses learned words that are not yet known well.
- Learners can add their own words with plurals, verb forms and example sentences.
- Free, no account, no ads. Progress is stored only in the learner's browser.

## Who it is for

Intermediate learners of Modern Standard Arabic who want to talk about ideas in Fusha: GCSE and A-level Arabic students, home-schooling families, parents learning the language of tarbiyyah, and adults in Quranic or Madinah-style Arabic classes.
